configuration: The three K1/K2/K3 parameter cases and four hydrogen FCC cells from upstream test_periodic_supercell_similarity, SAB_REPEATS=1.
observable: L2-normalized periodic K1 atomic-number, K2 inverse-distance, and K3 cosine MBTR arrays for the official primitive, 2x2x2, orthorhombic, and conventional cubic FCC cells.
default_vs_upstream: Nominal transcribes all three upstream parameter cases, all four upstream hydrogen FCC structures, and their descriptor settings exactly; Harbor only serializes the arrays and adds the calibration scale and repeat knob.
variant: ic/variant changes the lattice scale from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004 (two binary64 ulps); nominal therefore remains exactly the upstream geometry.
altbuild: none: the Debian image intentionally carries one GCC build; no independent alternative-build floor is available.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative-build floor is available; nominal-versus-variant Docker self-validation supplies the spread recorded in self_validation_spread.

warrant: Every physically indexed histogram bin produced by the official K1, K2, and K3 supercell-similarity cases is compared pointwise at finalized atol=1e-8 and rtol=1e-6. Omitting a periodic image, using the wrong geometry function, or normalizing a supercell incorrectly changes populated bins at a scale far above this bound. The bound is achievable because the deterministic float64 Docker calibration moved by only 3.885780586188048e-15 under the two-ULP lattice perturbation; the human finalized the common descriptor bound after the nominal case was restored to the pinned upstream test.
